title: Succinct Data Structures
summary: Edward Kmett's 2013 talk at Prezi in Budapest on succinct data structures, which store data in close to the information-theoretic minimum space while supporting fast queries. It ties together the research and walks through his Haskell succinct library.
why: Commenters credit it as the place they first learned about succinct data structures, and found it left a lasting impression.

quote.text: one of his many talks that left me with an incredibly lasting impression
